inference.seed_scheme: SHA256 UTF-8 ARG-GNN/Relate/v1.2.4/{master_seed}/{split}/{replicate}; first 8 bytes unsigned big endian modulo (2**31-1), plus 1
inference.coverage_policy: [first exported original SNP, last exported original SNP + 1); exact original grid only
inference.genotype_source: Cleaned parent observed.trees.gz only, never raw census truth.
inference.polarization: Simulated ancestral allele at observed mutation sites only; no invented ancestor FASTA

admission.parent_failure_policy: Fail the whole development stage with immutable failed-parent receipt. No score/class filtering, silent deletion, replacement or auto-resume.

relate_authorization.scope: Reviewed academic research use, no external redistribution

plan.note: Preparation execution freeze only. Does not freeze final test models/contrasts/analysis and cannot generate/access confirmatory cohorts.

simulation_protocol.selection: Preparation only. No model fitting by this wrapper. Later model/checkpoint selection uses fresh development VAL only.
simulation_protocol.evaluation: uniform fixed coordinates in complete true genealogies with census nodes and truth annotations removed
simulation_protocol.interpretation: Fresh independent development cohort, not final confirmation. 64TRAIN/16VAL/TEST0. All previous parents excluded by pre-generation seed-registry audit.
simulation_protocol.comparison_note: Split independent parent simulations before inference and8exact physical tiles. This configuration prepares inputs only and authorizes no final-test generation or scoring.

relate_installation.checksum_kind: locally computed SHA256 of official HTTPS archive, not an upstream signed digest

authorization.scope: research use only; no external redistribution

execution_permission: Only explicit --execute with this freeze's SHA256. Root owns scheduling.
